accounting: Increment attempted calls/actions/messages/tools before execution, including rejected operations. All public Session calls, automatic receive/history/context/private_put and stop count toward 512; trusted install_private and diagnostics do not. One send counts one message; injected A/B publication also counts. Evaluator time is within episode timeout. Preflight reserves full per-call token allowance; no refund or extra calls from small usage.
rationale: 24 invocations permit up to eight three-principal exchanges without prescribing a DAG. 12 read-only tool calls permit multiple query/refinement actions, shared across roles. 512 service actions cover context construction and explicit actions with headroom, independently of the historical 1000-action certification cap. 8192 output/240s follow the existing R3 operational configuration; no E2 task difficulty or outcomes inspected. 7200s covers 24*240 + 12*30 + evaluator120 with orchestration headroom. These are finite operational bounds, not power/accuracy-derived budgets; identical across families/arms.
